one_line: First Indian woman to earn a Western medical degree, studying at the Woman’s Medical College of Pennsylvania in the 1880s.

appearance.age_look: Early twenties, slight build, a little under average height, with a studious, somewhat fragile presence but a determined posture.
appearance.face: Soft oval face with a warm medium-brown complexion, straight brows over large anime-style dark brown eyes, a small straight nose, and gently defined lips; faint under-eye shadows hint at illness, but her default expression is calm, serious and quietly resolute.
appearance.hair: Glossy black hair parted in the center, drawn smoothly back and twisted into a low, neat bun at the nape of the neck; a thin off-white scarf (pallu) edges her hairline and drapes over her head and shoulders like a modest hood.
appearance.costume: Era-appropriate late-19th-century Maharashtrian-style sari worn in a modest draped fashion: a deep indigo cotton sari with a narrow maroon border and fine gold thread edge, pleated neatly in front and wrapped to cover the legs fully down to the ankles; beneath it a long-sleeved, high-necked choli in muted maroon cotton with simple gold piping, fully covering the torso; she wears a small round gold nose stud on the left nostril, simple gold stud earrings, a thin gold mangalsutra with tiny black beads, and a pair of plain glass bangles in indigo and maroon; on her feet are modest dark brown leather slippers, slightly Western-influenced but still flat and simple, suitable for city streets in Pune or Philadelphia.
appearance.signature: A worn, dark-brown leather-bound medical textbook held close against her chest in one arm, with a visible cloth bookmark and a small, brass-handled stethoscope looped around it by its cord.

ref_desc: Anandi Gopal Joshi is a slight, early-twenties Indian woman with an oval medium-brown face, large dark eyes, center-parted black hair in a low bun under an off-white pallu, wearing a deep indigo sari with maroon and gold trim, maroon long-sleeved blouse, simple gold jewellery, dark brown slippers, and holding a worn brown medical textbook with a small brass-handled stethoscope looped around it.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Anandi Gopal Joshi as a dignified young Indian woman from the 1880s: she has a slight build, looks in her early twenties, with an oval medium-brown face, large serious dark brown eyes, straight brows, a small straight nose, and faint under-eye shadows that suggest frailty but a calm, resolute expression. Her glossy black hair is center-parted, pulled smoothly back into a low bun at the nape of her neck, with a thin off-white pallu starting at the part and draping over her head and shoulders like a modest hood. She wears a historically accurate late-19th-century Maharashtrian-style sari in deep indigo cotton, with a narrow maroon border edged in fine gold thread, pleated in front and wrapped so that it modestly covers her legs fully to the ankles; underneath is a long-sleeved, high-necked maroon cotton blouse with simple gold piping that fully covers her torso. Add a small round gold nose stud on her left nostril, simple gold stud earrings, a thin gold mangalsutra with tiny black beads, and a few plain glass bangles in indigo and maroon on one wrist. On her feet are flat, dark brown leather slippers with a slightly Western-influenced shape but no heels. Her signature prop is a worn dark-brown leather-bound medical textbook held against her chest with one arm, a cloth bookmark peeking out, and a small brass-handled stethoscope looped around the book by its cord. Use a restrained palette dominated by indigo, maroon, warm medium-brown skin tones, off-white for the pallu, and touches of gold, and show her from multiple angles to emphasize the consistent hairstyle, sari drape, jewellery, footwear, and the ever-present book and stethoscope.
